thread.title: Top Stocks Today: Applied Materials, Lam Research Lead Semiconductor Rally | Investor's Business Daily

author: KEN SHREVE
title: Top Stocks Today: Applied Materials, Lam Research Lead Semiconductor Rally | Investor's Business Daily
text:
The Nasdaq composite was up sharply again late Thursday after two straight days of robust gains. The Nasdaq 100 served up plenty of top stocks today, including chip names Applied Materials ( AMAT ), Lam Research ( LRCX ), Microchip Technology ( MCHP ) and Maxim Integrated Products ( MXIM ).
X With about one hour remaining in the session, the Nasdaq composite was up 1.6%, but volume was tracking slightly lower than Wednesday's level at the same time of day. For an index to confirm a new uptrend, it's important to see conviction behind the buying. That always comes in the form of higher volume. The Dow Jones and S&P 500 rose about 0.9% each. The Russell 2000 outperformed with a 2.3% gain.
Broad-based strength in chip stocks helped the Philadelphia semiconductor index to a gain of nearly 5%.
Wall Street responded positively to strong earnings from Dow component DowDuPont ( DWDP ), but even with today's 7% gain, the stock is still about 24% off its high. Apple ( AAPL ), meanwhile, added 0.3% ahead of its earnings report after the close. While FANG stocks Netflix ( NFLX ) and Amazon.com ( AMZN ) fell 19% and 20%, respectively in October, Apple's decline was much smaller at 3%.
Other Top Stocks Today Church & Dwight ( CHD ) soared to a a new high on strong earnings. The household, personal care and specialty products maker is known for popular brands like Arm & Hammer, Trojan and Oxiclean. Church & Dwight's bullish chart was noted in the latest Earnings Preview column.
Elsewhere, strong earnings fueled a bullish breakout for Zoetis ( ZTS ), a producer of medicines and vaccines for pets and livestock. Shares were off highs but still rose nearly 5%.
In the health care space, Leaderboard name Repligen ( RGEN ) broke out with conviction from a flat base with a 59.09 buy point. Shares were up 16% to 63.06.
A breakout over a 216.10 buy point for health insurer Cigna ( CI ) looked good for a while, but shares reversed to a minimal gain. The stock was up 0.4% to 214.71 in late trading.
Inside the IBD 50 , top stocks today included HealthEquity ( HQY ). The stock extended gains after jumping above its 50-day moving average Wednesday. Shares were up another 3.5% to 95 as they work on a base with a 100.09 entry.
Finally, a merger in the oil and gas sector made headlines. Newfield Exploration ( NFX ) jumped nearly 13% after Encana ( ECA ) agreed to buy the oil and gas producer for $5.5 billion. Shares of Encana slumped around 15%.
At the New York Mercantile Exchange, U.S. crude oil futures were recently trading around $63.64 a barrel, down 2.6%.
